searchText: I just realized that retrieval of contract bytecode is going to exceed the UDP packet size and will have to be sent over uTP in most cases meaning that the CONTENT message of the FINDCONTENT/CONTENT pair can be any of 1) the content 2) ENR records that are closer 3) a uTP `connection_id` for the stream through which the content will be sent. I just finished what may be the most complete high level write-up of the plans for the state network: https://ethresear.ch/t/state-network-dht-development-update-2/9005 Even with code merklization? In theory with merkle/verkle retrieval could then be done piecemeal, but we're designing against the current protocol so currently not something we can take advantage of.
